title: MTAB: FastCraft MC
description: Bringing Legacy Console Crafting Back to Minecraft Java Edition.
body:
FastCraft brings the classic quick crafting experience from Minecraft Legacy Console Edition to Minecraft Java Edition.

Inspired by the crafting system found in the Xbox 360, Xbox One, PlayStation 3, and PlayStation 4 editions of Minecraft, FastCraft allows players to craft items quickly and conveniently through a dedicated crafting interface without manually arranging ingredients in the crafting grid.

Features
Quick crafting system inspired by Legacy Console Edition.
Craft items with a single click when the required materials are available.
Organized recipe categories for easy navigation.
Displays available and unavailable recipes in real time.
Simple and intuitive user interface.
Compatible with standard Minecraft crafting mechanics.
Designed to reduce crafting time and improve gameplay flow.
How It Works

Open the FastCraft interface and browse through recipe categories such as Building Blocks, Tools, Weapons, Food, and more. The mod automatically checks your inventory and displays all craftable recipes. Simply select an item and craft it instantly without manually placing resources into a crafting grid.

Why FastCraft?

Many players consider the Legacy Console Edition crafting system to be one of the most user-friendly crafting interfaces ever added to Minecraft. FastCraft recreates that experience for Java Edition, making crafting faster, simpler, and more enjoyable.

Whether you're a builder, explorer, adventurer, or technical player, FastCraft helps you spend less time managing recipes and more time playing the game.

Craft faster. Play longer.
